record.original_question: Given a plurisubharmonic function phi on the unit ball and Demailly's Bergman-type approximants phi_j built from the weighted Bergman spaces H(j phi), determine whether the Monge-Ampere masses at the origin satisfy (dd^c phi_j)^n(0) -> (dd^c phi)^n(0).

evidence.quote: Question 8 (Demailly). Does one have (dd^c phi_j)^n (0) -> (dd^c phi)^n (0) ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\varphi$ be a plurisubharmonic function on the unit ball $B \subset \mathbb{C}^n$. For each integer $j \geq 1$, let $\mathcal{H}(j\varphi)$ denote the Hilbert space of holomorphic functions $f$ on $B$ such that $\int_B |f|^2 e^{-2j\varphi}\, dV < \infty$, and let $K_{j\varphi}$ be the Bergman kernel of $\mathcal{H}(j\varphi)$ on the diagonal. Define Demailly's Bergman-type approximants
$$\varphi_j(z) := \frac{1}{2j}\log K_{j\varphi}(z).$$
It is known that $\varphi_j \to \varphi$ pointwise and in $L^1_{\mathrm{loc}}$ as $j \to \infty$, and each $\varphi_j$ has analytic singularities so that the Monge–Ampère measure $(dd^c \varphi_j)^n$ is well defined. Assume the Monge–Ampère mass $(dd^c \varphi)^n(\{0\})$ at the origin is well defined (e.g., $\varphi$ has an isolated singularity at $0$).

Determine whether the residual Monge–Ampère masses at the origin satisfy
$$(dd^c \varphi_j)^n(\{0\}) \longrightarrow (dd^c \varphi)^n(\{0\}) \quad \text{as } j \to \infty.$$
artifact.status_search_result: The question (a conjecture of Demailly) has been answered in the negative. Rashkovskii (arXiv:2012.15599, "Analytical approximations and Monge–Ampère masses of plurisubharmonic singularities", published in Math. Annalen 2022/23) constructs plurisubharmonic functions with isolated singularities for which the residual Monge–Ampère masses at the origin are not recovered as limits of the masses of the Demailly/multiplier-ideal analytic approximants, refuting the convergence conjecture.

status_evidence.title: Asymptotic multiplicities and Monge–Ampère masses
status_evidence.snippet: Examples of plurisubharmonic functions with isolated singularities whose residual Monge-Ampère masses at the origin cannot be approximated by masses of analytic approximations, answering negatively a conjecture of Demailly.
status_evidence.claim: The conjectured convergence of Monge-Ampère masses under Demailly's analytic approximation fails.

status_evidence.title: Analytical approximations and Monge-Ampère masses of plurisubharmonic singularities
status_evidence.snippet: We construct examples ... residual Monge-Ampère masses at the origin can not be approximated ... answers negatively a conjecture of Demailly.
status_evidence.claim: Negative resolution of Demailly's question on convergence of Monge-Ampère masses for Bergman/multiplier-ideal approximants.
